validation.evidence: Generated TypeScript derivatives reproduce from the approved contracts.
Format, lint and boundaries, lockfile integrity, immutable image pins, secret scan, typecheck, 61 unit tests, 56 contract tests, and 60 integration tests passed.
6 of 6 Chromium tests passed, including 5 US1 browser journeys.

contractEvidence.sessionBootstrap: One-time, short-lived, origin-bound, actual-loopback-only exchange with consumed failure attempts.
contractEvidence.projectApi: Authenticated create/read, idempotency conflict handling, optimistic version rejection, typed validation failures, finite replay, and live SSE are covered.
contractEvidence.providerBoundary: Scheduling selects only the two conformant fixture connection relations and independently retains connection plus descriptor ID/version provenance.

persistenceEvidence.migration: 002_start_observe.sql upgrades a version-1 database through the checksum-locked migration manifest.
persistenceEvidence.httpPath: The authenticated HTTP control-plane assembly persists PostgreSQL project snapshots and ordered project events and replays those durable events.
persistenceEvidence.atomicity: Project organization, scheduling result, events, and idempotency result commit in one PostgreSQL transaction.
persistenceEvidence.capacity: Concurrent PostgreSQL submissions serialize on durable capacity; the default four-specialist ceiling permits four and rejects five additional submissions without partial state.
persistenceEvidence.retention: Replay reads lock the snapshot retention boundary, concurrent expiry returns either a complete replay or EVENT_CURSOR_EXPIRED, and the watermark is capped at lastSequence + 1.

browserEvidence.validJourney: A submitted objective renders Product, Engineering, Quality, one depth-one specialist, nested channels, task state, presence, queue reason, and ordered activity.
browserEvidence.invalidJourney: Invalid objectives and exhausted organization capacity show actionable feedback without creating partial projects.
browserEvidence.liveDelivery: An event appended after the SSE connection opens appears in the activity log.
browserEvidence.cursorRecovery: When retention overtakes an open stream, the server emits stream.reset and the browser reloads ProjectView before resubscribing without duplicate activity.

eventOrderEvidence.ordering: Persisted and browser-visible project sequences are strictly increasing and gap-free within the retained range.
eventOrderEvidence.privacy: Public projections contain no private reasoning field or prohibited backend payload.

authorityEvidence.organization: Default four-specialist and 24-channel limits are enforced; configured channel values cannot exceed 64 active, 8 direct children, or depth 4.
authorityEvidence.time: Delegation deadline and lease timestamps are anchored to PostgreSQL clock_timestamp() inside the reservation transaction.
authorityEvidence.runtime: Task deadline, authority lease, and full delegated runtime are evaluated before backend start, and the authorized runtime budget is propagated to the backend command.

independentReview.finalTargetedValidation: 4 unit, 7 contract, and 7 integration tests passed independently.
